name: ReadyWise 84 Servings Gluten-Free Emergency Food Supply
modelNumber: 84 Serving Gluten Free Grab and Go Bucket
summary: An 84-serving gluten-free bucket reference with rice, soup, potato entrée and dessert. Servings are not complete meals; the manufacturer’s calorie figures and Canadian assortment need reconciliation.
description: Longer food storage requires a water and preparation plan as well as space on a shelf. The documented ReadyWise gluten-free bucket combines several dishes and dessert rather than 84 complete meals. Use the delivered pouch labels to plan actual energy intake and dietary suitability. The manufacturer page has inconsistent nutrition and dessert information, so this profile keeps the buying link pending rather than guessing which assortment the recorded Canadian ASIN contains.

specs.label: Documented assortment
specs.value: Manufacturer reference: 24 rice, 18 soup, 18 potato entrée and 24 dessert servings; Canadian ASIN assortment unconfirmed, and portions are not complete meals

specs.label: Declared energy
specs.value: Manufacturer marketing total: 15,420 kcal for its reference bucket; not an established nutritional total for B00TX5J74S

specs.label: Water planning
specs.value: Product-specific estimate: about 63 cups; use the instructions on each actual pouch

specs.label: Storage claim
specs.value: Up to 25 years under suitable storage; cool, dry conditions away from moisture, oxygen and light; not a guarantee

specs.label: Nutrition discrepancy
specs.value: Linked labels yield 15,180 kcal for the stated counts; dessert is called yogurt-style in the list but vanilla pudding in nutrition

pros: Several dish types can complement a broader food reserve.
Sealed pouches allow the contents to be prepared separately.
cons: Requires potable water and a practical preparation/heat plan.
Calorie total and dessert identity differ within manufacturer materials.
The exact gluten-free Canadian assortment, lot, expiry and current labels are unverified.
useCases: Plan a household food reserve alongside water, cooking equipment and familiar shelf-stable foods.
Compare labelled portions and calories with household needs instead of counting servings as days or meals.

research.identityNotes: Primary manufacturer materials reviewed. No physical testing, traceable calibration, seller authentication or live Canadian listing verification is claimed.

confirmed.text: The product page names an 84-serving gluten-free bucket, estimates 63 cups of water and describes cool, dry storage.
The displayed counts and labels give 24×270 + 18×160 + 18×190 + 24×100 = 15,180 kcal, not the headline 15,420. Rice declares soy; potato entrée and pudding declare milk.

unverifiedClaims: The actual Canadian bucket, pouch assortment, dessert, lot, dietary labels, dates and nutrition totals are unconfirmed; the source-label calculation is not a measured lot total.
safetyNotes: Gluten-free does not mean allergen-free. The linked rice label declares soy; potato and vanilla-pudding labels declare milk. Check every delivered pouch.
Do not infer ingredients or dietary suitability from the concept packaging; manufacturer page and label revisions do not fully agree.
Store unopened pouches as instructed, inspect seals and dates, and do not assume the advertised maximum shelf life applies after opening.
publicationBlockers: Independently establish the Canadian listing, delivered variant and safety documentation before full editorial publication.
